summary: Sprint-1 ExpenseSync backend tested end-to-end via public preview URL. 30/30 pytest cases pass covering: health, auth (session/me/logout), 401 enforcement on all protected routes, seed-sample counts (saved/duplicates/skipped), regex parser across HDFC/ICICI/Axis/SBI SMS + email formats, category classification (Swiggy→Food, Uber→Transport, Amazon→Shopping), promotional-SMS skip, dedup by ref_id and dedup by amount+normalized-merchant+date, transaction list filters (category/source/include_duplicates), GET single (with raw_text) + 404, PATCH category & is_duplicate with GET-verification, DELETE with GET-verification, and dashboard shape (month_spend, month_income, sorted by_category, duplicate_count, recent limited to 5, total_transactions) with duplicates properly excluded from month_spend. No MongoDB _id leaks in any response.

minor.issue: Endpoints are not idempotent from the client's perspective and there is no /api/messages/reset. Re-running seed-sample bloats duplicates monotonically. Not a blocker for sprint-1 but worth adding a reset/dev endpoint or gating seed to first-run.

'recent' returns non-duplicate txns only (filtered upstream). Product intent seems fine but PRD mentions a 'duplicate banner' — recent[] intentionally excludes duplicates so any UI-side duplicate list must call /api/transactions?include_duplicates=true separately (documenting, not a bug).

Suite is configured with -n 2 --dist loadscope. Because all tests share a single seeded user in the preview DB, cross-class parallelism causes fixture races (clean_txns in one class wipes data another class just seeded). Confirmed by getting 3 failures under -n 2 and 0 failures under -n 0. Recommend either serial run OR per-worker user isolation.

action_items: Optional: add per-worker user isolation in conftest (e.g., derive user_id from worker id) so pytest-xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope works without races. Current workaround: run with -n 0.
Optional: add POST /api/messages/reset (auth-gated) to wipe the caller's txns — makes demo/reseed cleaner for repeated seed-sample invocations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 522 lines — still under 700 but growing. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, parser.py, transactions.py, dashboard.py) when sprint-2 adds Gmail sync and charts.
get_current_user re-runs on every request and does two Mongo round-trips (session + user). Fine for sprint-1 volumes, but consider a $lookup pipeline or short in-memory cache when traffic grows.
regex_parse categorize() is called with merchant before merchant is trimmed — non-issue functionally, but calling it after merchant assignment would be slightly cleaner.

ai_parse tries json.loads on stripped ``` fences but does not handle 'json' prefix without newline consistently — low risk since regex catches 99% of Indian bank SMS; only a concern if AI fallback is exercised heavily.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py seeds user_id=user_test000001 / session_token=test-token-xyz-123 in Mongo per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. All test-created transactions are prefixed via that user and wiped by teardown; no other seed data introduced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable at 100%. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/ is reusable. IMPORTANT: run with `pytest -n 0` (serial) OR fix conftest to give each xdist worker its own user_id — otherwise the shared test user causes cross-worker races (3 flaky failures observed under -n 2). Public URL is https://smart-expenses-50.preview.emergentagent.com and the frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no production bugs found. The only 'issue' encountered during testing was pytest-xdist race on shared test user (documented above).
